about: React Native's Android APIs on OxyOS (sample/AndroidProbe.tsx). React Native's own modules run their Android implementation, but OxyOS is not Android: what it does not provide must fail visibly (unavailable or rejected), never succeed silently or leave its caller waiting. What it does provide answers truthfully. With no screen reader, isScreenReaderEnabled() and isAccessibilityServiceEnabled() answer false (scenarios/accessibility-info.json has one running); Reduce Transparency is the session's, off. Its ActivityIndicator is React Native's Android AndroidProgressBar, which the host does not implement: drawn as a plain view and reported, declared here as `unimplemented`; undeclared, the run fails.

texts: Linking.openURL: rejected: OxyOS did not open https://oxy.so: OxyOS opens a URL only for something the person did
